title: Antigravity agent frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter schema for Antigravity custom subagents (agents/<name>.md). Transcribed from https://antigravity.google/docs/subagents/ on 2026-09-28; no JSON Schema is published for it. Empirically confirmed against agy 1.2.12 in docs/verification/phase-0.md Check 5 — agy does NOT reject unknown keys, so additionalProperties is false here as a matter of forward-compatibility policy, not observed enforcement.

name.description: Unique identifier for the custom agent. Required.

description.description: Used by the planner to decide when to delegate. Required.

tools.description: Explicit allowlist of permitted tools, e.g. view_file, replace_file_content, grep_search, run_command.

mainAgent.description: Whether the agent may be selected as the primary agent in chat interfaces.

subagent.description: Whether the agent may be invoked via the invoke_subagent tool.

mcpServers.description: Custom MCP servers configured for this subagent.
